An enclosure locking component secures part of the selected access arrangement. Its mechanical mounting must be coordinated with the door, handle and any documented locking sequence.

For example, in an electrical cabinet with controlled maintenance access, use the Mi_DR_04_Werkzeugverschluss reference to coordinate lock interface, operating access and door movement. Show the neighbouring equipment and the connection route so the installer can understand the intended arrangement.
